# What reading each file in this folder gives. Replayed by
# test/core/sources/local/tag_shared_cases_test.dart (Dart) and
# native/linthra_core/src/tags/shared_cases_test.rs (Rust).
#
# TAB-separated: file, title, artist, album artist, album, track number,
# duration in microseconds, cover as hex. `-` is an absent field; a line of
# just `file<TAB>NONE` is a file the reader does not handle. Covers are read.
flac_tagged.flac	Hello	Alice	Various Artists	Album	3	3000000	0102030405
flac_collaboration.flac	Duet	Alice, Bob	-	-	1	3000000	-
flac_album_artist_underscore.flac	X	-	Label	-	-	3000000	-
flac_vinyl_side.flac	Side A	-	-	-	-	3000000	-
flac_odd_comments.flac	Kept	ß	-	Spaced	7	3000000	-
flac_blank.flac	-	-	-	Nel	-	3000000	-
flac_track_overflow.flac	-	-	-	-	-	3000000	-
flac_padding_cover.flac	Padded	-	-	-	-	3000000	0102030405
flac_no_length.flac	Unknown length	-	-	-	-	-	-
vorbis_tagged.ogg	Ogg	A	-	B	5	3000000	0102030405
vorbis_invalid_utf8.ogg	Kept	-	-	-	-	3000000	-
vorbis_48k.ogg	Half	-	-	-	-	2500000	-
opus_tagged.opus	Opus	-	AA	-	-	3000000	0909
opus_long.opus	Long	-	-	-	-	61000145	-
not_audio.mp3	NONE
empty.flac	NONE
truncated.flac	NONE
